_about: Battle bag fragment (List 17 #165) — the bag as a command class over #31's existing useContext.battle field. No item's context is edited here; no class value is set except the structural one. bagAccess is PROPOSED into #18's class table (its home disposes): threshold means S-SURVIVAL's existing item branch may fire; no new scorer is minted.

classes.wild: none — STRUCTURAL, not a balance value: a wild Mochi has no Ranger and no bag

bagAccess.flag: bagAccess: none | threshold (proposed per-class flag on #18's table)
bagAccess.stocks: an AI side's items are its encounter record's item list (#30/#37), decremented in battle; empty list = S-SURVIVAL's item branch scores nothing

model.captureJoin: a #38 attempt is a bag-class command: occupies the slot's turn, resolves via #38's staged checks in RESOLUTION; #158 legality is checked at command time, before the turn is spent
model.depletion: at resolution; a use voided by queue order is unconsumed — the turn was the price, not the item
model.multiJoin: #157: each controller's slots draw on that controller's bag; partner and Ranger never spend each other's
model.reachability: #31 useContext.battle == true, read verbatim; #31's category vocabulary untouched
model.turnCost: an item command is a peer command in #10's COMMAND_RING and resolves in RESOLUTION; the slot's creature does not also move

open_register: bagAccess values for ranger-young / ranger / dojo / elite-champion (owner balance)
